plays_when: in the Aerodromes of Rabanastre, Bhujerba, Archades, Balfonheim Port and Nalbina Town, as the party boards an airship and again as it lands. The boarding counter asks "How would you like to travel?" (By leisure craft. / By private cabin. / I've changed my mind.) and takes the fare. While event flag 2 (global 0xB76) is 0, either choice leads to the departure: the script reads and plays the scene, sets event flag 3 (global 0xB78) to 2, and takes the party by leisure craft to the Skyferry's Observation Parlour (field 124), or by private cabin straight to one of the Aerodromes. The Sky Saloon (field 125) takes the Observation Parlour's place when battle flag 1 (global 0xA74) is 1, which the counter sets on a random roll that depends on the progress of the Deathgaze hunt (quest 153, quest-menu-files-bin-rows.tsv). Once event flag 2 is 1, a leisure-craft booking still plays the scene, but a private-cabin booking clears event flag 3 and the clerk's talk takes the party straight to another Aerodrome with no scene (rbn_b01 lines 3780 and 3782). When an Aerodrome loads with event flag 3 at 2, its director reads and plays the scene again, then sets event flag 3 to 0 and event flag 2 to 1. Of the story scripts, only these five landings store to event flag 2, and each stores 1 (the developer test map evt_t0505 also sets it to 0). Rabanastre: rbn_b01 lines 220, 531, 533, 564, 579, 804, 806, 817, 1557, 1561, 1563 and 1564; the other four Aerodromes run the same script (byu_b01, alc_e01, var_b01 and nac_b01).
